probe: pinned CommandLineParser config/data path effects and server options across CLI, config, and environment precedence

config-and-environment-options.name: config-and-environment-options
config-and-environment-options.initialConfig:
port: 1234
listen: true
listenAddress:
  ipv4: 192.0.2.10
  ipv6: '2001:db8::10'
protocol:
  ipv4: false
  ipv6: auto
dnsPreferIPv6: true
heartbeatInterval: 9
browserLaunch:
  enabled: false
  hostname: config.example
  port: 8181
  avoidLocalhost: true
enableCorsProxy: true
disableCsrfProtection: true
ssl:
  enabled: true
  certPath: config-cert.pem
  keyPath: config-key.pem
  keyPassphrase: config-pass
whitelistMode: false
basicAuthMode: true
enableKeepAlive: true
requestProxy:
  enabled: true
  url: http://config-proxy:8080
  bypass: [config-host]

startup-settings-config-values.name: startup-settings-config-values
startup-settings-config-values.initialConfig:
cookieSecret: legacy-file-secret
enableUserAccounts: true
enableDiscreetLogin: true
securityOverride: true
perUserBasicAuth: true
rateLimiting:
  preferRealIpHeader: true
  accountsLoginMaxAttempts: 3.5
forwardedHeaders:
  xRealIp: false
  cfConnectingIp: true
  xForwardedFor: false
basicAuthUser:
  username: config-user
  password: config-password
skipContentCheck: true
performance:
  useDiskCache: false
backups:
  common:
    numberOfBackups: 7

startup-settings-environment-overrides.name: startup-settings-environment-overrides
startup-settings-environment-overrides.initialConfig:
enableUserAccounts: false
securityOverride: true
perUserBasicAuth: false
skipContentCheck: false
performance:
  useDiskCache: true
backups:
  common:
    numberOfBackups: 9
